Cath.name: Overall CAD (Cath ≥50%)
Cath.description: Composite obstructive coronary artery disease across any major branch

LAD.name: Left Anterior Descending
LAD.territory: Anterior myocardium & anterior interventricular septum (AHA Segments 1, 2, 7, 8, 13, 14, 17)
LAD.description: Left anterior descending artery supplying anterior wall and ventricular apex

LCX.name: Left Circumflex Artery
LCX.territory: Lateral wall & posterior base of left ventricle (AHA Segments 5, 6, 11, 12, 16)
LCX.description: Left circumflex artery coursing laterally around the coronary sulcus

RCA.name: Right Coronary Artery
RCA.territory: Right ventricle, diaphragmatic inferior wall, SA and AV nodes (AHA Segments 3, 4, 9, 10, 15)
RCA.description: Right coronary artery coursing through the right atrioventricular sulcus
